item.title: Cowan: Can new goalie coach get more out of Canadiens' netminders?
item.description: Marco Marciano has a history with Samuel Montembeault and Jakub Dobes and they appreciate the positive energy and passion he brings to job.

item.title: Opinion: Ramadan reflections on faith and secularism
item.description: Quebec’s institutions are neutral and must remain so. But state neutrality does not require suspicion toward the religious lives of citizens.

item.title: Notorious killer whose crimes shocked Quebec bails out of parole hearing
item.description: "I think that (after what the parole board heard) this morning, you can't grant me anything," says Marcel Blanchette, serving a life sentence for the sexual assault and murder of Isabelle Bolduc, 22, in 1996. He will try again for parole in July.

item.title: Cars should be allowed on new road to REM station, Pierrefonds mayor says
item.description: Earlier plan by the Plante administration envisioned a road reserved for buses and bicycles — but no cars.

item.title: How the Olympics enriched and energized Canadiens centre Oliver Kapanen
item.description: "I hope I left an impression" with a strong performance in Finland's bronze-medal win over Slovakia, he says. "I wanted to show (my style)."

item.title: A PQ government could wait till end of Trump's term to hold referendum
item.description: Party leader Paul St-Pierre Plamondon says exact timing of independence vote has to remain adjustable to reflect certain economic realities, but critics accuse him of backpedalling.

item.title: Why did everyone think Ghislaine Maxwell was in Quebec City?
